section13_checks.violation_evidence: The artifact schema_id is 'orch.tier5.excellence_section.v1', which begins with 'orch.tier5.' and therefore identifies this as a Phase 8 Tier 5 deliverable subject to the categorical pre-condition of §8.4 and §13.4. No budget response file has been received from the external Lump Sum Budget Planner system. Absent budget artifacts constitute a blocking gate failure per CLAUDE.md §8.4 and §13.4; this state is not a hold state and admits no deferral.' The excellence_section.json artifact — a full Phase 8 proposal section draft including sub-sections 1.1 through 1.4, full validation_status, and a populated traceability_footer — was produced without a passing budget gate. section13_checks.prohibition_description: Storing durable decisions only in agent memory without writing them to Tier 4 decision log or phase outputs
Allowing a workflow or skill to become a de facto constitutional authority by redefining phase meanings, tier meanings, gate logic, or the authority hierarchy
Silently reordering phases or weakening gate conditions to allow workflow progress when inputs are incomplete
Finalizing proposal text when source state is known to be incomplete, contradictory, or unvalidated, without explicitly flagging the gap in the deliverable
Using agent-local knowledge of Horizon Europe programme rules as a substitute for reading Tier 1 source documents when those documents are present and accessible
section13_checks.violation_evidence: The artifact contains MSCA participation condition claims that constitute Horizon Europe regulatory-level requirements asserted without any Tier 1 normative framework path in the traceability_footer.primary_sources[]. Specific instances: (1) Claim C15 asserts the MSCA mobility eligibility rule — 'no more than 12 months residence or main activity in the host country in the 36 months immediately preceding the submission deadline' — sourced exclusively to docs/tier2b_topic_and_call_sources/extracted/scope_requirements.json SR-02 (Tier 2B only); (2) sub-section 1.4 content states 'SR-01 (scope_requirements.json, Confirmed, mandatory) positions the fellowship instrument as requiring excellent researchers undertaking international mobility — excellence of the researcher is not peripheral context but the instrument's central individual-level selection criterion', sourced to Tier 2B only; (3) the content asserts 'If the real host is in a non-associated Third Country the fellowship becomes a Global Fellowship with a mandatory 12-month return phase and three-way knowledge-transfer model (SR-03, scope_requirements.json, source_grounded)'; (4) MSCA doctoral-degree eligibility criteria are stated as regulatory requirements without Tier 1 backing in the footer. The traceability_footer.primary_sources[] lists no path within docs/tier1_normative_framework/extracted/ — all Tier-2 references are Tier 2B sources (scope_requirements.json, expected_outcomes.json, expected_impacts.json). MSCA participation conditions derive from the Framework Programme Regulation and MSCA-specific primary legislation; their use in the deliverable without a Tier 1 traceability anchor in the footer is a §13.9 violation.

decision_log_entries.resolution_note: Constitutional violation detected; requires human operator resolution. A Phase 8 Tier 5 proposal section (schema_id: orch.tier5.excellence_section.v1, run_id: msca-pf-syn-01) was produced without a passing budget gate. The budget gate assessment at docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase7_budget_gate/budget_gate_assessment.json records gate_pass_declaration: 'fail' with a blocking inconsistency: no budget response has been received from the external Lump Sum Budget Planner system in docs/integrations/lump_sum_budget_planner/received/. CLAUDE.md §13.4 and §8.4 impose a categorical and unconditional block on all Phase 8 activity — including preparatory drafting — until gate_09 is satisfied. The excellence_section.json artifact must not be used as the basis for proposal submission, further drafting, assembly, or evaluator review until a conforming budget response is received, validated against the interface contract, and the budget gate assessment is rerun with gate_pass_declaration: 'pass'. No Phase 8 substep may commence before that condition is met.

Constitutional violation detected; requires human operator resolution. The excellence_section.json artifact contains MSCA participation condition claims and Horizon Europe programme-level regulatory requirements (MSCA mobility rule SR-02, researcher excellence requirement SR-01, Global Fellowship return-phase requirement SR-03, MSCA doctoral-degree eligibility conditions) without any Tier 1 normative framework path in the artifact's traceability_footer.primary_sources[]. All regulatory-level references trace only to Tier 2B scope_requirements.json. Resolution options: (1) revise the artifact to include explicit Tier 1 extracted source references for all participation condition claims — for example, paths within docs/tier1_normative_framework/extracted/ for the Framework Programme Regulation and MSCA provisions that are the legislative source of these conditions; or (2) confirm through a Tier 4 decision log entry that the Tier 2B scope_requirements.json extraction has been directly and fully grounded in Tier 1 normative documents and that Tier 2B references constitute sufficient traceability for these claims in this repository's tier model, recording that determination with the relevant Tier 1 authority citations. Severity is major, not critical; it does not independently block downstream use but must be resolved before finalisation per §11.5.
